Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
Many thanks for your letter, I send the [agreement](/topic/160), with which I am quite satisfied. I also send by train four nos of the [Christian Remembrancer](/periodical/59) containing four papers
Folk Lore & Old Stories
[Lord Seaton & his Regiment](/book/66)
[The La Ferronays family](/book/64)
[Eugenie de Guérin](/book/50)
There are also- only I have not disinterred them [Miss Sewell’s Principles of Education](/book/302) and the [Life of Bishop Mackenzie](/book/52) but these will be enough for you to see whether they are available.[^1]
The Ghosts as you see are in Folk Lore. If advisable I could expand that a good deal - and make a little volume of it.
I have not signed the agreement as I should like you to fill it up first lest I should do it incorrectly

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: CMY wanted Macmillans to publish a volume of her unpublished non-fiction articles, but the idea never came to anything.
